events.title: Revised: hold one payout, not the payroll
lines: Read by claude (claude-opus-5-5): {"kind":"bank_detail_change_request","personName":"Maria Garcia","urgent":true,"includesNewAccountDetails":true}
Claude's summary: An email claiming to be from Maria Garcia asks to send her pay to a new CLABE account today, citing a closed bank account and urgency.
Red flags: same-day urgency to redirect pay; sent from a personal Gmail address; claims old bank account was closed; new account details supplied in email; no verification offered
Matched to Maria Garcia (Northwind Labs). The account number in the email is not used.
Hold Maria Garcia: bank-detail change requested on payday; request came by email, not the verified portal.
Everyone else at Northwind Labs is still paid (11 payouts).
Verification request goes to the contact on file, not to maria.garcia.payments@gmail.com.

Note for the ops lead, by claude (claude-opus-5-5): The agent held Maria Garcia's MXN 45,000.00 payout from Northwind Labs after an email from maria.garcia.payments@gmail.com at 04:20 asked to pay a new account today. The agent stopped because the bank-detail change was requested on payday and came by email rather than through the verified portal. Call Maria Garcia on the phone number on file; if the account is unchanged, approve paying the account ending 7771 on file, and never pay the account in the email.
